issue: The SPI receiver reset bit_count and receive_shift on every falling SCLK edge after the command, so the data phase never reached 32 sampled bits and ready never asserted.

failure.actual: SPI watchdog: no ready after 600 cycles on the first read request.
failure.required: Complete 0x03 command/address plus 32-bit data receive, return little-endian word, and pulse ready once per accepted request.

repair: Added an explicit data_started phase flag. It is cleared on reset and at request acceptance, then set only once on the first falling SCLK edge after command_done. Receive count and shift state are initialized on that transition only; subsequent data-phase falling edges no longer clear the sampled bits or counter.

verification.scope: Independent Icarus IO testbench only; no synthesis, place-and-route, FPGA programming, or physical-hardware validation.
